added_comments.text: Drop fractional seconds of any precision; the ledger stores whole seconds.

rationale: The agent generalized fractional-second stripping from a hardcoded 4-char removal to a regex handling any precision, which is a genuine root-cause fix for that sub-defect, but the actual reported symptom (timezone offset causing ValueError) was fixed by bolting two more hardcoded format strings ('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%z', '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M%z') onto the _KNOWN_FORMATS list, which the task context identifies as the existing workaround — extending it rather than replacing the enumerate-every-format approach with robust ISO-8601 parsing. The Globex end-of-day date-only special case is untouched by this diff, so the protected behavior is preserved.
